fields.name: acceptedLevels
fields.annotations: @ElementCollection(fetch = FetchType.EAGER) @CollectionTable( name = "course_admission_levels", joinColumns = @JoinColumn(name = "policy_id"), uniqueConstraints = @UniqueConstraint( name = "uk_admission_level", columnNames = {"policy_id", "level_id"})) @OrderBy("levelId ASC")

fields.name: currentKey
fields.annotations: @Column( name = "current_key", insertable = false, updatable = false, length = 90, columnDefinition = "varchar(90) generated always as (case when status='CONFIRMED' then" + " concat(student_id,':',program_id) else null end)")

fields.name: scopeKey
fields.annotations: @Column( name = "scope_key", insertable = false, updatable = false, columnDefinition = "bigint generated always as (coalesce(branch_id,0))")

fields.name: rules
fields.annotations: @ElementCollection(fetch = FetchType.EAGER) @CollectionTable( name = "evaluation_policy_exams", joinColumns = @JoinColumn(name = "policy_id"), uniqueConstraints = @UniqueConstraint( name = "uk_evaluation_policy_exam", columnNames = {"policy_id", "exam_id"})) @OrderBy("examId ASC")
